asked: # Let vps.build_start launch Fable builds A previous run (`build-start-fable`, local clone /root/axf-builds/build-start-fable, never pushed) was stopped part-way; peek at its uncommitted diff there if useful (`git -C /root/axf-builds/build-start-fable diff`), but do the work here. Brett wants Fable builds running ASAP. Read CLAUDE.md and the repo rules first. 1. `vps.build_start` model enum is only opus|sonnet. Add `fable`, mapped to the exact model name/alias the installed Claude Code CLI on this VPS accepts for Fable (check `claude --help`, the CLI's model options, and how AmberX-AXF's build orchestrator names Fable). If the CLI rejects it, report exactly what it says. 2. Make allowed models config-driven (default opus, fable; Brett's rule is Opus or Fable only, never Sonnet, so drop sonnet from the default list). Schema enum generated from config. build_list shows each build's model. 3. Tests for schema + mapping, decision log entry, STATUS/THREADS notes. 4. This one needs to go LIVE fast: when tests pass, merge origin/main, push HEAD to main and redeploy axHub the way the repo documents (Coolify). Then one live test: launch a tiny Fable build via the same code path that just prints the model it runs on, confirm, stop it. Never print secrets. Short report: enum before/after, exact CLI model name for Fable, deploy done or not, live test result. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.

result.summary: vps.build_start launches Fable (--model fable = claude-fable-5-1); models from config.buildModels (default opus, fable; no sonnet); build_list shows model. Pushed to main 998f03f, redeployed, live Fable test passed
